details: id baseline-imagination-check, phase 1, essential, core, 1 to 2 h, no prerequisites. Draw the same ten prompts from imagination, 5 to 10 minutes each (a person running, a dog, a chair, a car, a tree, a room, a street corner, a hand holding a cup, a face looking up, an invented creature). Photograph and store. Repeat the identical set as part of every benchmark; the gallery shows the sets side by side.
reason: The goal is drawing from imagination, yet no check measures it over time. A repeated fixed prompt set is the most direct, self-assessable progress measure for that goal.

details: id organic-forms-contours, phase 4, essential, core, 6 to 12 h, prerequisites found-basic-shapes and persp-box-basics. Sausage and organic forms, contour lines that wrap form, overlapping organic forms and soft intersections. Map to the organic forms and intersection exercises of Drawabox Lesson 2 (unverified).
reason: Plants, insects, birds, reptiles, mammals and the figure all build on organic forms with contour lines; no module teaches it, and Drawabox places it (Lesson 2) before plants, insects and animals.
sources: search: result title 'Drawabox Lesson 2, Exercise 2: Organic Forms with Contour Lines'

details: id simple-3d-blockout, phase 4, deepening, core, 3 to 6 h, prerequisite persp-box-basics. Navigate Blender (or a free posable figure tool), add primitives and one light, set a camera, screenshot. Make it the prerequisite for any practice item that uses Blender, and mark those items as alternatives.
reason: Nine modules ask for Blender work (persp-construct-primitives, persp-intuitive, persp-shadows, persp-slopes, light-basic-forms, light-direction-types, light-cast-shadows-ao, light-invented-light, persp-imagination) and none teaches it.
